name: Customer Success agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread)
description: Phase 3 skeleton golden set per customer_success.spec.md §7. Eight cases across the four D34 locales covering the friction-signal taxonomy + the three task-brief escalation conditions (retention_risk=critical, insufficient_grounding_evidence, no_high_confidence_intervention). The 100-workspace golden snapshot (spec §7) lands in tests/golden/customer_success/*.json during Phase 4 once BigQuery analytics.funnel is wired.

metadata.note: Canonical first-time operator with 0/2 completion, 12 invocations — agent proposes csm_outreach (high) + feature_demo (medium).
